name: line-swap
description: A masked full-line beat replacement: line A holds center then exits up through an overflow-hidden mask as line B enters bottom-up on the same beat, with an optional accent underline drawing beneath one word of line B.

vars.description: First line; holds center inside the mask, then exits up on the swap beat.
Replacement line; enters bottom-up on the swap beat and holds.
Second (from mount start) of the beat replacement. Clamped so the swap and underline complete before any exit.
First case-insensitive substring match in line B gets the accent underline after landing. Empty disables it.
Underline color from the contract token map.
Optional departure. Default none: the landed line holds until the frame cuts.
